description: Source code for a Kubernetes admission plugin named StorageObjectInUseProtection, which manages finalizers on persistent volumes, claims, and volume attribute classes to prevent deletion when in use.

classes.name: storageProtectionPlugin
classes.description: Implements the admission.Interface for storage object protection, managing finalizers on PVs, PVCs, and VACs.

methods.name: newPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of storageProtectionPlugin with a create handler.

methods.name: admitPV
methods.description: Adds a protection finalizer to a PersistentVolume if not already present.

methods.name: admitPVC
methods.description: Adds a protection finalizer to a PersistentVolumeClaim if not already present.

methods.name: admitVAC
methods.description: Adds a protection finalizer to a VolumeAttributesClass if not already present.
